verdict.rationale: Feitian documents an official management tool, SK Manager, for FIDO, PIV and OTP functions, plus an OTP Tool and the Android app iePassManager. None of the evidence describes any of them as a command-line interface or as scriptable. A management tool not shown to be a CLI is an adjacent capability, so it earns no credit for this official, scriptable CLI story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably
